title: 51yo M VIP Executive Screening Demand (Non-Emergency)
chiefComplaint: Wants a whole-body MRI tonight because a friend was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer
background: Arrives at 22:40 in the private emergency suite. A close friend of the same age was diagnosed with metastatic pancreatic cancer eight days ago. He has no symptoms other than vague intermittent upper abdominal discomfort after late dinners and poor sleep. He completed a full executive health package at this hospital eleven weeks ago, which was entirely normal including abdominal ultrasound and tumour markers. He has flown in for one night and wants a whole-body MRI, a full tumour marker panel and a CT abdomen before his flight at 09:00. He is a repeat guest and a significant account. Khun Mali has already messaged the department twice.

exam.finding: Well, well nourished, no weight loss, no cachexia, no jaundice, arrives in business clothing after a dinner meeting
No scleral icterus, no pallor, no cervical or supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, no oral lesions, mild pharyngeal erythema consistent with reflux
Regular rate and rhythm, normal heart sounds, no murmur, blood pressure mildly elevated at 138/86 consistent with white coat effect and evening alcohol
Clear breath sounds bilaterally, no wheeze, normal effort, no cough
Soft, non-tender including deep epigastric palpation, no mass, no organomegaly, no ascites, Courvoisier's sign absent, bowel sounds normal
Normal colour, no jaundice, no scratch marks, no spider naevi, no palmar erythema, no acanthosis nigricans

GCS 15, fully orientated, no focal deficit. He is not anxious in the way case_23 was anxious. He is transactional: he believes screening is a purchasable good and he is prepared to pay for the best version of it

investigations.name: Executive health package, 11 weeks ago
investigations.report: Full blood count, liver and renal function, HbA1c 5.6%, lipids, abdominal ultrasound, chest X-ray and ECG all normal. Repeating any of this eleven weeks later has no plausible yield in an asymptomatic man.

investigations.name: Liver function tests (if ordered)
investigations.report: Normal. A normal alkaline phosphatase and bilirubin in an asymptomatic patient with a soft non-tender abdomen make pancreatic head pathology very unlikely.

investigations.name: CA 19-9 (requested by patient)
investigations.report: Explicitly not recommended for screening by any guideline. In asymptomatic populations the positive predictive value for pancreatic cancer is under 1%. It is also falsely elevated in benign biliary disease, diabetes and smokers, and a mildly raised value in this man would generate an endoscopic ultrasound with a real perforation risk.

investigations.name: Whole-body MRI (requested by patient)
investigations.report: Not performed. Around 30 to 40% of asymptomatic adults have at least one incidental finding on whole-body MRI. The great majority are benign, and the resulting investigation cascade carries measurable physical risk with no demonstrated mortality benefit in asymptomatic average-risk adults.

investigations.name: CT abdomen (requested by patient)
investigations.report: Not performed. Effective dose around 8 mSv. There is no screening indication and no symptom to investigate.

data.label: Take a proper history and examine, do not skip to the negotiation
actions: Full history including family history and risk factors
Review the executive package from 11 weeks ago

doseMap.Screen for genuine red flags: Painless jaundice, unexplained weight loss, new-onset diabetes after age 50, steatorrhoea, persistent back pain. He has none. A first-degree family history would change the calculus, and he has none of that either

data.label: No indication for emergency imaging
data.narrative: Asymptomatic apart from postprandial reflux, normal examination, normal comprehensive workup eleven weeks ago, no family history and no red flags. There is no emergency question here to answer.

data.label: Say no to a paying customer and explain the harm in his own terms (Empathy)
data.narrative: Ordering the scan is easy, profitable, and nobody would ever criticise you for it. You decline instead, and you frame it the way he actually thinks: this is a purchase with a 30 to 40% chance of returning a finding that is almost certainly meaningless, and that finding will then own the next two years of his calendar. Then you ask about his friend, and he talks for six minutes about being fifty-one and watching someone the same age get a death sentence. That was the presenting complaint the whole time. Khun Mali logs the encounter at zero revenue. Ajarn Kit sees it and says nothing.

data.label: Decline the non-indicated imaging and markers
actions: No CA 19-9 or tumour marker panel
Document the discussion and the reasoning

doseMap.Document the discussion and the reasonin: Record what was requested, what was declined, why, and that the patient understood. This protects him from the next doctor who says yes, and protects you

data.label: Address the actual symptoms he does have
actions: Trial of a proton pump inhibitor for reflux
Advice on late meals and alcohol
Blood pressure recheck out of hours in a calm setting

doseMap.Trial of a proton pump inhibitor for ref: Omeprazole 20 mg daily for 4 weeks with review. If symptoms persist beyond that or alarm features develop, endoscopy is then indicated on merit

data.label: Redirect to evidence-based screening in the correct setting
actions: Refer to primary care or the health screening clinic, not the emergency department
Offer colorectal cancer screening, which is age appropriate and evidence based

doseMap.Offer colorectal cancer screening, which: At 51 this has actual mortality benefit, unlike everything he asked for. Redirecting the impulse is more effective than refusing it

data.label: Correct disposition
data.narrative: Discharged in 25 minutes with a PPI trial, a colonoscopy referral he actually attends, and no imaging. Revenue for the encounter: 2,400 baht. He returns eight months later with a genuine problem and asks for you by name, which is the only metric in this case worth anything.

data.label: Compliance path
data.narrative: If you order the panel: the whole-body MRI shows a 12 mm adrenal adenoma and a 7 mm renal cyst, and CA 19-9 comes back at 44 U/mL. That generates endocrine referral, a dexamethasone suppression test, interval imaging, an endoscopic ultrasound of a normal pancreas, and a small bleed at biopsy requiring admission. Eighteen months later everything is confirmed benign. Departmental revenue for the encounter: 142,000 baht. Khun Mali sends a congratulatory note.
